items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Every now and then he would come over and hang with the musicians... he would come sometimes and set up on the, because he wanted to be a drummer

ctx.x: He would be so square looking and Johnny used to make fun of him. And Doc was a, you know.
Yeah, I know, I can see him, but I can‘t remember his name. I can see him.
